text:
alex (AE): quick presales thread for MaplePay POC. they're in Canada and want tenant traffic to stay in Canada/EU only. fallback to US or APAC is NOT allowed unless explicit emergency declared. also asking about on-prem connector for logs + list of subprocessors per region. pricing question: can we offer a small monthly 'regional isolation' premium instead of Dedicated?

maya (SE): two parts: (1) routing policy + hard-blocks, (2) audit delivery. hosted platform supports tenant affinity and prefer-region, but hard-blocks (deny routing to specific regions) require Dedicated/Private. we can do a soft-failover policy that prefers CA regions and EU but will fall back to a 'walled' emergency path only with manual ops approval.

alex (AE): customer wants manual ops approval and a signed emergency runbook. willing to pay for Dedicated if needed, but asks if hosted + contractual controls + monthly premium is possible as a faster path to close.

darren (Infra): technical detail: hosted fallback map: ca-central-1 -> ca-east-1 -> eu-west-1 -> us-east-1. we can mark us-east-1 as quarantined but not enforceable without Dedicated. manual emergency override requires a 2-person ops approval and will be logged; we can restrict automatic failover to zero. audit logs can be exported to customer S3 via secure transfer. on-prem log connector (agent) exists but supported only with Dedicated/Private.

sophia (Legal): contract options: 1) Hosted + contractual 'no-automatic-cross-border' clause + monthly premium + attestation obligation from our side. still includes subprocessors in non-CA regions for backups unless customer takes Dedicated/Private. 2) Dedicated/Private with BYOK and subproc exclusion. We can draft an emergency override clause (manual approval, documented incidents, capped usage) and a short attestation template. Need exact emergency approval flow the customer expects.

rui (Sales Eng): pricing mechanics: we can do a "regional isolation add-on" on Hosted: monthly fee (~+20-35% of base list) that covers extra monitoring, 24/7 ops approval window, and S3 audit exports. Dedicated pricing is much higher but gives BYOK and subproc controls. For compliance-heavy customers, Dedicated is usual. I'll draft two quotes: Hosted+isolation add-on vs Dedicated.

alex (AE): Sophia  can you sketch the emergency override legal wording? Darren  can you prepare the minimal ops approval flow we would require? Maya  can you confirm which features can be delivered on Hosted vs Dedicated and any timeline risk?

maya (SE): Hosted deliverables: tenant affinity, prefer-region lists, S3 audit export, manual ops-driven emergency routing (requires 2-person approval), monthly attestation report. Not deliverable on Hosted: BYOK for model keys, hard subproc exclusion, on-prem agent for logs. Dedicated/Private: all of the above.

sophia (Legal): I'll draft a short exception: - No automatic cross-border routing unless explicit written emergency declared by Customer and approved by Redwood ops (2-person sign-off). - Emergency window limited to 72 hours per incident, max 2 incidents / year, then escalate to Dedicated migration. - Redwood will provide a signed attestation and a full subprocessor list within 5 business days after any emergency. - Egress charges during emergency are credited up to a capped monthly allowance unless Customer elects to pay actuals. Need customer's cap preference.

alex (AE): customer asks for a 1TB/month egress credit cap during emergencies. Also wants subprocessor list by country now.

darren (Infra): current subprocessor footprint: ca-central-1 (Redwood-hosted infra in Canada partner), eu-west-1 (Redwood infra), backup/replication points in us-east-1 (partner cloud) and ap-southeast-1 (edge caching). For Hosted, the partners 'canada-cloud-co' and 'global-logging-svc' would appear on the subproc list. Dedicated removes third-party compute partners. We'll prepare CSV of subprocessors and SOC2 certs.

rui (Sales Eng): I'll model pricing: Hosted base + isolation add-on (+30%) + 1TB emergency egress credit included; Dedicated quote TBD. I'll attach both as options in the proposal deck.

ops-bot: safemode-test: attempted auto-failover blocked by policy at 2027-03-15T11:22:10Z; manual override required. audit log: s3://redwood-ci/maplepay/1938456123/block-test.log :white_check_mark: 

alex (AE): great, team. Sophia  please include the 72hr cap + 2 incidents/yr language and the 1TB credit clause. Darren  prepare subproc CSV and SOC2s. Rui  draft the two quotes. I'll send to customer for sign-off after we have draft contract language.
